meta.title: Lua compiler improvements
meta.body_summary: Optimize Lua compiler to skip helper calls for indexing simple lists/strings, update boolean printing to match golden expectations, regenerate Lua machine outputs, and note new capabilities in README.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI Codex contributed a Lua compiler direct-indexing optimization; author self-merged instantly despite 27 golden test failures and no performance evidence or review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 473 changed lines across 111 files, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, but primarily consisting of test expectation updates. It fits a small-step compiler optimization PR that was self-merged by the author without any external review, despite 27 test failures being reported.

review_details.concern_detail: No reviewer provided feedback; the PR was merged by the author immediately after creation.
review_details.performance_claim: Lua compiler skips helper calls when indexing simple lists or strings, reducing overhead.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent delivered a functional compiler optimization; the author self-merged without any maintainer review or validation of performance claims, and despite 27 failing tests.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiler, or reproduction steps; 27 golden test failures were reported but ignored.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: 27 test failures were explicitly noted in the PR body but the PR was merged without any fix.

core_change_summary.description: The Lua compiler was optimized to infer direct indexing for simple lists and strings, eliding helper calls. The commit also updates golden test output files and boolean printing, reflects the new machine outputs, and notes new capabilities in the README.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most changes are in test expectation files (.lua and .out) reflecting the removal of helper calls and updated boolean output. The compiler source changes are small (expressions.go +7/-4, runtime.go +2/-1).
change_trajectory: Single commit 'lua: infer direct indexing' added to PR.
PR immediately merged by the author without any review or interaction.

collaboration_trajectory: Author opened PR with a single commit containing the compiler optimization and test adjustments.
Within 32 seconds, the author merged the PR with no external review or human feedback.
